results.statement: atm-bd must assign a sanity or qa bead only when bd ready lists it and, checked afterwards, no ATM task with that bead id exists; a bead whose task the hook already assigned is never assigned a second time.
results.quote: There is the possibility of a race condition, however the atm-task-close hook would immediately call 'atm task assign' and 'bd close' we could even call 'atm task assign' before 'bd close'  (ideally these are both done in a single shell command so the delay is ~1ms, much faster than the cron/poller would see the problem.  We could insure the poller looked at 'bd ready' first and in the case 'bd ready' was true then check ... then check 'atm task' for assignment.  (this should avoid race condition).
results.context: phase-bj planning 2026-10-18: Rand's close-hook and mechanical-assignment rulings (atm-core #1873 comment 1, atm-bd-orchestration #340, PR #342)
results.deterministic_check: dispatch.py reads bd ready first and atm task list second for each candidate; a tick against a sanity bead whose task the hook assigned emits no assign action
